_comment: Recognised failures and what to tell the user about them.
Both the Monitor and the Configurator render errors through this catalogue,
so a cause is explained the same way wherever it surfaces, and adding a new
one means adding an entry here rather than editing either GUI.
Each issue is matched against the raw error text. 'match_any' hits when any
pattern is present; 'match_all' additionally requires every pattern. Patterns
are case-insensitive substrings unless the entry sets "regex": true.

match_any: still running until this machine is restarted
issues.summary: The driver is blocked until this machine is restarted
issues.detail: Memory Integrity has been switched off, but it keeps running until the next boot, so it is still refusing to load the device's driver.
issues.action: Restart the machine to finish applying the change, then try again.

issues.summary: The device driver is being blocked by Windows Memory Integrity
issues.detail: Memory Integrity (Core Isolation / HVCI) refuses to load drivers that predate its signing requirements, so the driver never starts and the device cannot be opened even though it is plugged in and listed.
issues.action: Turn off Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > Memory integrity, then reboot. On a managed machine this may be set by IT policy and need their help.

issues.summary: The BIOPAC driver is not responding
issues.detail: The unit is connected but Windows cannot drive it, so mpdev could not open it.
issues.action: Open Device Manager and look for a warning on the BIOPAC unit. If it shows error code 39 the driver failed to load; reinstall the BIOPAC driver, and check whether Memory Integrity is enabled.

issues.summary: Another program is using the BIOPAC unit
issues.detail: Only one program can hold an MP unit at a time.
issues.action: Close AcqKnowledge, BSL, or any other BioView window using the unit, then try again.

issues.summary: The configured BIOPAC model does not match the attached unit
issues.detail: The unit rejected the model, connection type or port it was asked for.
issues.action: Check the 'model' in your configuration matches the hardware (MP36, MP150, MP160) and that the connection type is right for how it is attached.

issues.detail: Nothing answered on the USB or network connection.
issues.action: Check the unit is powered on and connected, and that its driver is installed.

issues.summary: The USRP's FPGA image does not match the installed UHD
issues.detail: UHD and the image on the radio come as a matched pair, and this radio is carrying an image from a different UHD release, so the driver refuses to open it.
issues.action: Run uhd_images_downloader on the server machine, then flash the radio with uhd_image_loader and power cycle it. If UHD itself was upgraded recently, every radio needs re-flashing.

match_any: dll load failed while importing libpyuhd
issues.summary: The UHD Python bindings do not match the installed UHD
issues.detail: The 'uhd' module imported successfully but is not the one the installed driver provides -- usually a bindings build for a different Python version, or a stray uhd.py on the path.
issues.action: Install the UHD Python API from Ettus Research built for this Python version, and make sure no file named uhd.py sits on PYTHONPATH. Then restart the BioView server.

issues.summary: The USRP driver (UHD) is not installed on the server
issues.detail: BioView could not import the UHD Python module, so no USRP can be discovered or opened.
issues.action: Install the Ettus USRP Hardware Driver with its Python API on the server machine, then restart BioView.

issues.summary: A device backend could not be loaded on the server
issues.detail: The Python package or driver that backend needs is missing, so none of its hardware can be used.
issues.action: Install the missing dependency on the server machine and restart BioView.

match_any: could not resolve the serial number
issues.summary: A USRP could not be identified
issues.detail: The radio named in the configuration was not among the devices found.
issues.action: Check the radio is powered on and attached, and that the device name in your configuration matches one the Configurator lists.

issues.summary: The device operation did not finish in time
issues.detail: The server was still working when the client gave up waiting.
issues.action: Retry. If it keeps happening, check the server log for the device that is hanging.
